lessons_used: Finish new screen changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (+1.0% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and sign_in hint changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all tests so far resulted in no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests, particularly for redesigns (predicted +12.0%, measured -3.4%) and new flows (predicted +2.0%, measured -4.6%).

candidates.title: Account Sync Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Displays a reassurance hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that existing pet data is bound to your account so progress won't be lost.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet status and collection are safely saved to your cloud account.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in hint without breaking any rules.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 27.1% and support evidence is strongest (8 emails). Low-cost hint change.

candidates.title: Pet Care Basics Checklist
candidates.change: Adds a pet care checklist screen right at the finish stage introducing how to feed, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion after onboarding on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet (3 emails).

new_pet_care_checklist.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_care_checklist.body: Learn how to summon, feed, or hide your new pet directly from your desktop system tray.

components.text: Right-click system tray to hide/show pet
Click pet directly to open interaction menu

guard.reason: Adds a valid new pet care checklist screen after home_intro while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish loses 35.2% of users. Previous finish new_screen tests averaged +1.0%, though cost is high.

candidates.title: Photo Generation Error Prevention Hint
candidates.change: Adds a guidance hint on photo upload detailing clear lighting and face visibility requirements to reduce pet generation failures.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure single subject, good lighting, and clear front view for optimal pet generation result.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo upload guidance without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%). Hint change is config-only with reasonable evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Status Check
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a split layout featuring a direct desktop visibility verification button.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to display after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: If you don't see your pet wandering around, check your taskbar or click locate pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro overlay cleanly within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with support emails, but redesigns previously underperformed target expectations.

candidates.title: Pet Hatching Status Notification
candidates.change: Enables desktop notification toggle and clear status messaging on the waiting screen while the pet is being generated.
candidates.why: The home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s leading to drop-off while waiting.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your New Companion
waiting.body: We are generating your pet graphics. We will send a desktop notification when ready.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen while maintaining its primary function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time at home step, though home step drop-off is relatively low (18.7%).

candidates.title: Choice Story Scroll Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose path screen layout to story_scroll format with structured pet selection choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion, indicating hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion's Journey
choose_path.body: Scroll through available companion paths and select your preferred adventure.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path layout while retaining choice options.

candidates.score_note: Targets choose_path hesitation, but redesign changes have weak/negative historical evidence.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stage
candidates.change: Changes the adoption certificate screen layout to stage format featuring an animated pet mascot component.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long completion times (mean 1017s).

guard.reason: Replacing components with only a mascot removes the required official stamp from the certificate.

candidates.title: Fast Track Sign In Options
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in options area with prominent authentication badges to prevent screen stalls.
candidates.why: 2 emails reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to load properly.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Tip Carousel Flow
candidates.change: Adds interactive tip carousel components and time estimate indicators to the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: Waiting screen has high drop-off and very long average wait times (mean 2336s).

components.text: Did you know? You can customize pet sounds in settings later.

guard.reason: Adds informative carousel and estimated wait time during real waiting step.

candidates.score_note: Addresses home wait times with interactive flow, but new_flow showed negative historical lift (-2.0%).

candidates.title: Path Story Intro Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story screen using a card layout with step counters to orient new users.
candidates.why: Story screen entry point has 76.2% conversion and users spend up to 514s on average.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Get ready to adopt a pet that lives directly on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen card while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesign aimed at initial screen drop-off; low historical confidence for redesign formats.
